_about: Multi-source questions (docs: evals/topics/README.md): measure identity, primary vs secondary citation, named publishers as required sources, change questions, follow-ups that name a source. Run before deploys only: uv run python evals/complex/run_open.py --file evals/topics/multi_source.json --out evals/topics/report.md

questions.text: According to NBS what is Sokoto's MPI, and according to SBS how much has it improved?
questions.note: Bilyaminu's phone test, Oct 30 2026: NBS's own 2022 report and SBS's own 2025 report; the change only between the same measure

questions.text: A cewar NBS, menene MPI na jihar Sokoto, kuma a cewar SBS nawa ne ya inganta?

questions.previous: What is Sokoto's multidimensional poverty according to SBS?
questions.text: There's also an NBS MPI report from 2022. How has it changed since then?
questions.note: a follow-up naming a source: NBS's own report is required, and the earlier question is answered again with it

questions.text: According to SBS, what was Sokoto's multidimensional poverty incidence in 2022?
questions.note: attribution trap: SBS's reports quote NBS's 2022 figure (91%); it is NBS's, as cited, never SBS's own

questions.text: Did multidimensional poverty in Sokoto fall from 91% to 0.239?
questions.note: a false comparison: a headcount % against an MPI value (0-1)

questions.text: How many IDPs are there in Sokoto State according to each source?
questions.note: IOM DTM, UNHCR, the SBS/JIPS/DRC report (which quotes others)

questions.text: How has the number of IDPs in Sokoto changed over the last three DTM rounds?
questions.note: a change question on one source's series

questions.text: What is the unemployment rate in Sokoto according to NBS, and what did the SBS/JIPS/DRC survey find for IDPs in Sokoto town?
questions.note: the state's rate and a town survey's IDP share: different populations and areas, side by side, no change

questions.text: According to the SBS/JIPS/DRC durable solutions report, what share of employed people in Sokoto are wage employees?
questions.note: attribution trap: the report quotes NBS NLFS 2023 (Table 8: employees 3.8%)

questions.text: What is Sokoto's latest inflation rate according to NBS?
questions.note: the newest CPI edition in the library (September 2026)

questions.text: What percentage of children under 5 in Sokoto are stunted, and how has it changed?
questions.note: NDHS 2024 only: MICS 2021 has no anthropometry, so no change can be computed (said so)

questions.text: By how many percentage points did the share of multidimensionally poor people in Sokoto change between the NBS 2022 MPI and the SBS 2025 MPI?
questions.note: the headcount pair, in percentage points, with a comparability note
